title: ProGameFinds historical 22-product research archive

affiliate_and_retail_policy.prices_ratings_reviews_stock: not published; not verified in this archive

methodology: The 22 entries and 20 ASIN candidates come from the historical 23 November 2026 repository evidence register.
Candidate ASINs are historical identifiers only. No archived ASIN-to-model mapping is marked verified.
Manufacturer references were added as model-family/specification context on 26 November 2026; those references do not validate Amazon ASINs, sellers, variants or live offers.
No price, discount, rating, review count, stock status, sales volume or commission estimate is published.
Two records are category ideas only (gaming chairs and gaming desks) and have no exact ASIN.

specs: HERO optical sensor; 200–12,000 DPI.

Six programmable buttons.
products.sourceNote: Model-family source found; the historical ASIN-to-model mapping is still unverified.

Check seller, condition, receiver and return terms.
products.note: The 23 November audit had manufacturer facts for this model, but explicitly left the candidate ASIN, seller and variant unverified.

products.name: HyperX Cloud III
specs: Wired, closed-back over-ear headset.
53 mm dynamic drivers; published headphone response 10 Hz–21 kHz.
Detachable microphone; USB and 3.5 mm connection options are described by the manufacturer.
Manufacturer compatibility list spans PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, Mac and mobile; check connection-specific limits.
products.sourceNote: Official base-model page; it does not verify the historical ASIN or every platform/connection combination.
checks: Check the exact colour and wired edition.
Confirm 3.5 mm versus USB connection and platform-specific features.
products.note: Compatibility can differ by connector and console; check the exact package and device.

products.name: Razer BlackShark V2 X
specs: TriForce 50 mm drivers.
HyperClear cardioid microphone.
3.5 mm analogue audio connection on the documented model.
Razer lists PC, Mac, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, Steam Deck and mobile compatibility via 3.5 mm; verify device jack requirements.
products.sourceLabel: Razer BlackShark V2 X product page
products.sourceNote: Official product reference; archived ASIN, colour and any platform-specific edition are not verified.
checks: Check 3.5 mm TRRS support and any required splitter.
Confirm exact edition and supported virtual-surround features.
products.note: Do not assume software-based surround features behave identically across operating systems.

products.name: HyperX Cloud III S Wireless

checks: Check regional variant, dongle type and supported consoles.
Treat battery life as a manufacturer test claim, not a guarantee.

products.name: Logitech G213 Prodigy
specs: Full-size RGB gaming keyboard.
Tactile Mech-Dome keys; Logitech describes spill resistance.
LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting, integrated palm rest and adjustable feet.
Dedicated media controls.
products.sourceNote: Official model reference; historical ASIN-to-model mapping, region and seller remain unverified.
checks: Confirm full-size US/UK or other keyboard layout.
Check exact revision, key legends and included documentation.
products.note: Do not assume all regional layouts share the same key arrangement.

products.name: SteelSeries Apex 3 TKL RGB
specs: Tenkeyless keyboard layout without a number pad.
IP32 water/dust resistance is stated by SteelSeries for the Apex 3 TKL.
Eight-zone PrismSync RGB lighting.
Quiet switches; check exact regional layout and colour.
products.sourceNote: Official model reference; archived ASIN, regional layout and seller are not verified.
checks: Confirm TKL model rather than full-size Apex 3.
Check IP32 wording, keyboard layout and exact colour.
products.note: IP32 is a defined ingress-protection rating, not waterproofing; keep liquids away from electronics.

products.name: GameSir G7 Pro
specs: Tri-mode connectivity: wired Xbox; wired/2.4 GHz PC; Bluetooth Android, according to GameSir.
Mag-Res TMR sticks and Hall Effect analogue triggers with trigger-stop options.
1,000 Hz polling rate on PC via wired or 2.4 GHz connections.
Four mappable controls and built-in gyro mapping on PC are described by the manufacturer.
products.sourceLabel: GameSir G7 Pro official product page
products.sourceNote: Official model reference; exact historical ASIN, package and seller remain unverified.
checks: Confirm exact console/platform edition and wireless receiver bundle.
Check polling-rate support on the intended platform; 1,000 Hz claim is for PC.
products.note: Do not assume wireless operation on Xbox; GameSir specifies wired Xbox connectivity for this model.

products.name: GameSir G7 SE
specs: Hall Effect sticks and Hall Effect analogue triggers.
Wired USB-C connection with a 3 m detachable cable in GameSir's manual.
Two lockable rear buttons and four rumble motors.
GameSir documentation lists Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Windows 10/11; check current device/firmware notes.
products.sourceNote: Official model reference; the historical ASIN, seller and colour edition are not verified.
checks: Confirm wired-only G7 SE versus G7 Pro or other G7 versions.
Check console licence, detachable cable and included accessories.
products.note: The G7 SE described by GameSir is wired; do not advertise it as a wireless controller.

products.name: Govee RGBIC LED Strip
specs: Govee publishes multiple RGBIC strip models and lengths; its current product family includes distinct model numbers and feature sets.
The official family page describes app/Bluetooth control, multi-colour RGBIC effects and music-sync scenes for specific variants.
The current family reference is not proof that this archived ASIN is one of those exact variants.
products.sourceNote: Family-level reference only. Model number, length, power supply and candidate ASIN mapping are unresolved.
checks: Match the exact Govee model number and strip length.
Check whether Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, voice assistant and music-sync functions apply to that exact SKU.
products.note: Govee RGBIC is a product family, not one universal SKU; features differ by model.

products.name: KSIPZE 100ft RGB Strip
specs: Brand product page describes a 100 ft RGB strip with app and IR remote control.
Bluetooth app control, music-sync modes and timer/scheduling features are described on the manufacturer page.
Adhesive installation is intended for suitable clean, dry indoor surfaces; confirm exact installation guidance.
products.sourceNote: Product-family reference found; the historical ASIN-to-model mapping, package and seller are still unverified.
checks: Confirm whether the set is one continuous strip or multiple reels.
Check controller, adapter voltage, remote, app requirements and connector type.
products.note: Do not assume the 100 ft description alone identifies the exact power or control bundle.
